kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Persian دند (dand, “tooth; Croton tiglium”), clipped from دندان (dandân, “tooth; Croton tiglium”). The alternative forms are influenced by Ancient Greek δενδροειδής (dendroeidḗs, “tree-like”).
g: the name of certain purgative spurges, particularly Croton tiglium, and also Euphorbia dendroides, Euphorbia lathyris, Euphorbia characias
